mission.title: Missing Operative
mission.briefing: An undercover operative working for an allied Haven has stopped communicating from a remote Supply-mining operation. The operative's transmitter code has been provided. Travel to the mining operation, determine what happened to the operative, and recover them if possible.

nodes.text: Visitors check in with Reynolds inside.

responses.text: Who is responsible for Gate security?
Your checkpoint procedure is sloppy. Who authorized this?

nodes.text: Same as usual. Reynolds handles anyone who needs more than directions.
Nothing you need to worry about. Reynolds can answer questions.
Reynolds. Why?
You can take that up with Reynolds.
Keep your voice down. I can move once the patients are safe or the source is contained. If you clear the yard checkpoint first, I can slip out early.

responses.text: Stay put while we make a route to the Gate.

nodes.text: I don't know what they're doing with the sick people. They keep telling us to stay out of the way.

responses.text: Where do they keep spare supplies?

nodes.text: Help if you're here to help. Don't start opening things you weren't asked to open.

responses.text: Why are these people being kept here?

nodes.text: They've been pushing this equipment harder every week.

responses.text: Who told them to keep running it?
We will take a look. Stay clear of the unstable equipment.

nodes.text: The overseer. He wants more output, whatever the cost. If you are checking the equipment, look at the lab readings too. Just do not tell him I sent you.

observations.text: The transmitter code confirms this is the missing operative.
The local test logs contain repeated field pulses and output anomalies. They have useful measurements, but no consistent explanation.
The device has separable rig connections. Safe isolation needs a verified account of the pulse cycle.
The characterized pulse and aligned output suggest a directed weapon role. Its operating limits still need controlled testing.

actions.label: small talk
actions.outcomeText: The worker reveals a concealed entrance beside Holding. The hidden store is now accessible.

actions.label: inquire
actions.outcomeText: The worker reveals a hidden safe room behind the Overseer office. Its concealed door is now visible.

actions.label: inspect: Mounted device
actions.outcomeText: Compared the local logs with repeatable measurements: output diverges during the rig extraction cycle. The pulse behavior is characterized and a Research question is recorded. The device remains unidentified; its maker and full capabilities are unknown.

actions.label: collect: Mounted device
actions.outcomeText: Isolated the rig connections and detached the same complete device safely. It is eligible for Receiving recovery, with its field findings preserved.

actions.label: inspect: Report terminal
actions.outcomeText: Compiled a detailed report from the characterized device findings. The report is now in shared party inventory.

discoveries.label: How does the advanced mining technology alter or increase Supply extraction?
What produces the repeatable electromagnetic pulse, and why does output diverge during the rig extraction cycle?
